role: Index of the five white papers in docs/whitepapers with their PDFs, the source revision/scoring version they describe, and version history.

units.does: Index of five papers: papers 1-4 describe Emuqu at e028039 (2026-10-07), scoring version v3.1.oct2026; paper 5 the design method; code is authoritative where they disagree. Lists each paper's .md and .pdf (all ten files exist in docs/whitepapers/) and points to Tools/validation/ (exists) for the cross-implementation scripts. Version history: all published 2026-10-08; v1.3 for papers 1-4, v1.1 for paper 5 (matches the paper headers). ScoringVersion.current is v3.1.oct2026.
